reason: This is not a routine store-local tweak: it changes GC worker behavior to a new GC API and adds keyspace-level GC, which directly raises storage/kv consistency and isolation risk. GC bugs can be Blocker/High severity because they can delete wrong data, violate safepoint/keyspace boundaries, or break cluster cleanup semantics. The metadata also shows supporting changes in helper/error plumbing plus non-store touchpoints, which increases integration risk.
